what: Two samples packed with `pocket pack <name> --web`, served by tools/scripts/web_evidence.py and driven from the page through window.pocket; hello.png and sprites.png were written by the runtime's own `capture` command inside the browser (WebGPU readback through Asyncify) and posted back by the page.
browser: Chromium 152 (the Claude desktop app's built-in browser, macOS, devicePixelRatio 2; the mobile viewport preset reports an Android user agent)
toolchain: Emscripten 6.0.9, SDL3 port 3.4.2, emdawnwebgpu port, FreeType 2.14.3 and HarfBuzz 12.3.0 rebuilt with the Emscripten toolchain (`pocket setup --target wasm`)

sprites.input: the page's canvas was clicked, then the D key was pressed 40 times; input.state showed move_x down with value 1 and the Player entity moved from x 2.30 to x 5.10 (world.get Transform)

ui.text: Score 4   Coins left 2 (the HUD label, shaped by HarfBuzz and rasterised by FreeType in the browser)

sprites.resize: viewport emulation 640x400 CSS px -> the runtime reported pixel_width 1280, pixel_height 800 within two seconds

sizes_bytes.note: before font subsetting hello.data was 16487901 bytes (the full Noto Sans CJK font); a pack is now 6.3 MB, almost all of it the runtime

ui.text: the HUD shows 中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Ünïcödé: one font, shaped by HarfBuzz, with the buttons and health bar; ui.stats reported 24 nodes; capture 1010x750 posted as ui.png

text_input: ui sample, pause menu: a real click on the name field, then typing Léa 中文 through the page's hidden field; the field and the HUD label read PlayerLéa 中文 (the caret was at the end; the engine's field has no select-all yet)

saves.how: save.write {slot: web1} in one page load; after a reload save.list returned the slot with its data (IDBFS mount reported ready with no error)

editor.seen: script contexts editor + project, paused, 82 UI nodes: toolbar (Play/Step/Stop/Undo/Redo/Save scene), Hierarchy (9), Inspector, Console/Events/Transcript; capture 1010x750 posted as editor.png

font.note: the editor's strings are ASCII, so the subset did not grow
